description_en: Queries the applications for which a specified user has obtained access permissions through per-application authorization by paging. You can filter results by delivery group ID, delivery group name, application ID, or application name using fuzzy match
description_zh: 分页查询指定用户通过按应用授权获得访问权限的应用，可按交付组 ID、交付组名称、应用 ID、应用名称进行模糊筛选
name: ListAuthorizedAppsByUser

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Required. The value is case-insensitive.

This operation queries per-application authorization records. This authorization method applies to WUYING Cloud Application delivery groups. Valid values:

CloudApp: WUYING Cloud Application
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。必填，取值不区分大小写。

本接口查询的是按应用授权的记录，该授权方式适用于无影云应用交付组。取值：

CloudApp：无影云应用
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The page number of the results. Required. The value starts from 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果的页码，必填，从 1 开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Required. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数，必填，取值范围为 1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The delivery group ID used to filter results. Fuzzy match by containment is used. This parameter can be combined with other filter parameters. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428506.html operation to obtain the delivery group ID
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID，用于筛选结果。按包含关系模糊匹配，可与其他筛选参数组合使用。可调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428506.html 接口获取
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The application ID used to filter results. Fuzzy match by containment is used. This parameter can be combined with other filter parameters. You can obtain the application ID from the Apps list returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600836.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用 ID，用于筛选结果。按包含关系模糊匹配，可与其他筛选参数组合使用。可通过 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600836.html 接口返回的 Apps 列表获取
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The username to query. Required. The user must already exist under the current account. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436936.html operation to obtain the username
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的用户名，必填。该用户须已存在于当前账号下，可调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436936.html 接口获取用户名
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The delivery group name used to filter results. Fuzzy match by name is used. This parameter can be combined with other filter parameters
parameters.help_zh: 交付组名称，用于筛选结果。按名称模糊匹配，可与其他筛选参数组合使用
parameters.name: app_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en: The application name used to filter results. Fuzzy match by name is used. This parameter can be combined with other filter parameters
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称，用于筛选结果。按名称模糊匹配，可与其他筛选参数组合使用
parameters.name: app_name

Apps.description_en: The list of applications authorized to the user. Each record corresponds to one application within one delivery group
Apps.description_zh: 已授权给该用户的应用列表。每条记录对应一个交付组内的一个应用

AppIcon.description_en: The URL of the application icon. This value is empty if the deployment details of the application cannot be obtained
AppIcon.description_zh: 应用图标的访问地址。无法获取该应用的部署详情时为空

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the delivery group to which the application belongs
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 该应用所属交付组的 ID

AppInstanceGroupName.description_en: The name of the delivery group to which the application belongs. If the delivery group information cannot be obtained, the value is the same as AppInstanceGroupId
AppInstanceGroupName.description_zh: 该应用所属交付组的名称。无法获取交付组信息时，返回值与 AppInstanceGroupId 相同

AppName.description_en: The application name. If the deployment details of the application cannot be obtained, the value is the same as AppId
AppName.description_zh: 应用名称。无法获取该应用的部署详情时，返回值与 AppId 相同

AppVersion.description_en: The application version. This value is empty if the deployment details of the application cannot be obtained
AppVersion.description_zh: 应用版本。无法获取该应用的部署详情时为空

AppVersionName.description_en: The application version name. This value is empty if the deployment details of the application cannot be obtained
AppVersionName.description_zh: 应用版本名称。无法获取该应用的部署详情时为空

AuthorizedUserCount.description_en: The number of authorized users for the application within its delivery group. This value is empty if the deployment details of the application cannot be obtained
AuthorizedUserCount.description_zh: 该应用在所属交付组内已授权的用户数量。无法获取该应用的部署详情时为空

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned results

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of authorization records that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的授权记录总数
